flags: The cached SR-158 article names SR-156 in its July 1998 designation sentence. The designation itself is supported elsewhere in the article, but its date is omitted.

The cache does not establish road construction history, curves, grades, driving duration, or the designating agency’s rationale. The overview uses documented roadside history instead; it cannot provide a full road-origin narrative. The overview is deliberately shorter than 200 words because route evidence is limited.
Material has no strip towns or mileages. Retained coordinates and Forest Service directions establish the south-to-north moment order.

Robber’s Roost and Mahogany Grove moments are shorter than 90 words because the non-logistical evidence is thin. The anonymous bandit legend is omitted under the attribution rule; the Forest Service explicitly says its truth is unknown.

The supported winter parking and uncleared-trail note from current is omitted because this story does not require seasonal driving instructions. No practical note is added solely for hiking conditions.
